messages:
grace: deploy-bot reports canary instability for notifications-svc chart v2.0.0 in us-west-1 10% canary shows ImagePullBackOff in az-1, successful in az-2. tagging @tom @priya. should we pin region or try AZ fallback?
deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10%. Event: BackOff pulling image "registry.internal/notifications-svc:2.0.0" in node pool az-1. (bot)
tom: looks like the node pool in az-1 is behind on kubelet creds rotation so it can't pull from the new regional registry mirror. mirror returns 403 for that pool. az-2 is fine.
priya: options: 1) rollback to 1.9.5 for us-west-1 and pin in manifest; 2) retry canary with node-selector to force az-2 only (quick but will skew traffic); 3) coordinate infra to rotate creds then re-run (ETA ~25m). I prefer option 2 to keep forward-moving if we can run a targeted canary to az-2 only.
grace: deploying to az-2 only could mask az-1 issues though. if we do that we should add a note and schedule immediate remediation for az-1. rollback is safest if users in az-1 would be impacted.
tom: impact estimate: ~30% of us-west-1 traffic from az-1. that's user-impacting. I'm leaning rollback-and-pin until creds rotation completes. command: `deploy-bot promote --chart notifications-svc:1.9.5 --region us-west-1 --force-rollback && deploy-bot pin --chart notifications-svc:1.9.5 --region us-west-1`
ci-bot: CI status: manifest pin PR template ready. Release lint passes.
priya: ok let's rollback and pin. I'll open the pin PR and coordinate with infra for a creds rotation ASAP.
grace: release-bot draft a rollback blurb we can publish once done.
release-bot: Draft note: "Rollback notifications-svc to v1.9.5 in us-west-1 due to regional registry credential rotation mismatch preventing image pulls in az-1. Action: pin region, rotate node-pool creds, re-promote v2.0.0 after verification."
priya: pin PR merged. initiating rollback now.
deploy-bot: Promotion executed: notifications-svc promoted to 1.9.5 in us-west-1 (forced rollback). Canary at 10% -> healthy.
tom: infra scheduled creds rotation for az-1 in 18m. once rotated, we should add a pre-promotion check: `regmirrorctl auth-check --region us-west-1 --nodes az-1` to CI. filing infra ticket: https://git.company/infra/issues/1133
grace: release-bot, update notes with timeline and follow-up ticket.
release-bot: Release notes updated and follow-up ticket linked.
priya: recap owners: tom 1 infra creds rotation, priya 1 pin & notes, grace 1 coordinate re-promote after validation. ETA re-promote ~30m after creds rotation.
grace: thanks everyone, closing thread. :white_check_mark:
